tarantuverse.title: A new Analytics page
tarantuverse.body: Analytics is now one page that starts with what needs you: who's due to eat, the last molt and the longest gap since a meal. Premium keepers also get molt history, collection growth and spending.

tarantuverse.title: 20 feeder species to choose from
tarantuverse.body: Link a feeder colony to one of 20 feeder species, from crickets and dubias to fruit flies, springtails and isopods, each with care notes to start from.

tarantuverse.title: Track what your collection costs
tarantuverse.body: Log feeders, substrate, enclosures and vet bills, split a purchase across the animals it's for, and see what each one costs to keep.

tarantuverse.title: Printable sitter care sheets
tarantuverse.body: Going away? Print or save a care sheet for the animals you pick, with feeding, water and safety notes for whoever is looking after them.

tarantuverse.title: Photo timeline
tarantuverse.body: Flip through an animal's photos in date order, with each molt marked, and compare the first and latest side by side. Wrong date on a photo? You can fix it now.

tarantuverse.title: Your own cost per feeding
tarantuverse.body: Advanced Analytics can now use what you actually pay per feeding instead of a flat 50¢ guess.

tarantuverse.title: Photos for millipede care guides
tarantuverse.body: Eleven more millipede care guides now have photos, all openly licensed and credited.

herpetoverse.title: Track what your collection costs
herpetoverse.body: Log feeders, substrate, enclosures, heating and vet bills, split a purchase across the animals it's for, and see what each one costs to keep.

herpetoverse.title: Printable sitter care sheets
herpetoverse.body: Going away? Print or save a care sheet for the animals you pick, with feeding, water and safety notes for whoever is looking after them.

herpetoverse.title: Photo timeline
herpetoverse.body: Flip through an animal's photos in date order, with each shed marked, and compare the first and latest side by side. Wrong date on a photo? You can fix it now.
